verdict.rationale: Qualcomm documents its own SDKs for Snapdragon X-series PCs: the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK, Qualcomm AI Hub for optimizing and deploying models to the Hexagon NPU, and the open-source GenieX toolkit, plus sample app repositories. The evidence does not tie these SDKs explicitly to the X2 Elite Extreme, and no SDK reference documentation or hands-on build reports appear in the pack. missing for 10: explicit X2 Elite Extreme SDK support statement, SDK API/reference documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
